translationRepairs: Governor Malaqi and Governor-General Ma Hu wrote: "Tianyan is honest, capable, and energetic. He is clearing long-standing tax arrears and untangling misallocated payments, but the task is unfinished. We ask that he be permitted to observe mourning without leaving his post."

Governor-General Malaqi and Governor Ma Hu wrote: "Tianyan is honest, capable, and energetic. He is clearing long-standing tax arrears and untangling misallocated payments, but the task is unfinished. We ask that he be permitted to observe mourning without leaving his post."
s0010 has 總督麻勒吉、巡撫瑪祜: 總督 belongs to Malaqi and 巡撫 to Ma Hu. The original English reverses the offices; the proposed Governor-General / Governor pairing matches the Chinese.
Jiangnan's waterways form a dense network. As provincial treasurer, Tianyan asked Governor-General Ma Hu to dredge the silted Wusong and Liu rivers.
Jiangnan's waterways form a dense network. As provincial treasurer, Tianyan asked Governor Ma Hu to dredge the silted Wusong and Liu rivers.
s0027 has 請於巡撫瑪祜; 巡撫 is provincial governor, not governor-general. Changing Governor-General Ma Hu to Governor Ma Hu corrects the office title.
Jiangnan's waterways crisscross one another. While Tianyan was provincial treasurer, he asked Governor-General Ma Hu to dredge the silted channels of the Wusong River and the Liu River.
Jiangnan's waterways crisscross one another. While Tianyan was provincial treasurer, he asked Governor Ma Hu to dredge the silted channels of the Wusong River and the Liu River.
The literal likewise renders 巡撫瑪祜 as Governor-General; Governor Ma Hu is the accurate title for 巡撫.

s0194 ends 蓋天顏、阿山亦弗能喻也; 喻 means understand/grasp, not compare. The proposed 'could not understand it' restores the sense of 弗能喻.
